ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.44 (Ryde voucher per NS-7) to the rider for the unexempted 1.73 km off-route segment; keep the rest of the metered fare. No account flag.

segment_findings.reason: No rider consent before the 17:41 segment start: the complete, timestamped chat (F7, F8, F9) holds only the 17:24 arrival messages, which name no road or route; the driver's reroute account appears only in his post-trip statement (F10), which is a claim, not consent under RD-5 (G11). RD-3 also fails: no stop was measured and the rider named no place. RD-4 gives no exemption — F13's 17:16 Seletar Expressway accident is not tied to this segment and F11's band 4 is flowing traffic and only corroborative under RD-4(b) (RD-4(a) marked ✗). Extra km and distance from the optimal route do not create an exemption.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4(a) fails on the trace and on the facts: F13's accident was reported 17:16, before pickup at 17:28, and nothing in the record ties it to the 17:41–17:44 segment (F3); a claimed 'lanes blocked' justification resting on the driver's post-trip statement (F10) cannot override the system records (F11, F13) [F3][F10][F11][F13][RD-4].

RD-4(b) expressly makes a speed band corroborative only and it cannot exempt a segment alone; F11 shows band 4 (30–39 km/h), outside the band 1/2 congestion definition, so it does not corroborate a blocked-road reroute either [F11][RD-4].

The $0.00 refund presupposes the F3 segment is exempt, which it is not; with one unexempted segment RD-2 yields 1.73 km × $1.4102/km = $2.44, so the metered total of $40.18 (F6) does not stand in full [F3][F4][F6][RD-2].

Correct that RD-4 turns on traffic evidence rather than consent, but that traffic evidence fails (see D1/D2), and the absent rider message in the complete chat (F7, F8, F9) also means no RD-5 consent and no RD-3 rider-named stop excuses the segment [F7][F8][F9][RD-4][RD-5].

Accepted as far as it goes — the +5.6 min (F2) is not charged back and no time-based refund is made — but congestion evidence cannot exempt the measured F3 detour, so it does not defeat the partial refund [F2][F3][F11][F13][RD-4].
Correctly withdrawn: RD-6 requires an upheld route violation in the profile and route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 (F16), so no account flag attaches [F16][RD-6].

The conclusion (segment unexempted) is right, but the framing that F11's band 4 'contradicts' the driver is not what decides it: band evidence is corroborative only and F13 fails the RD-4(a) timing/link to the segment, which is the operative failure [F3][F11][F13][RD-4].
